findings.description: The diff adds `export { COMMIT_SHA } from './merge-gate.constants.js'` only so `land.service.ts` keeps importing it from here.
findings.body:
This PR moves `COMMIT_SHA` into `merge-gate.constants.ts`, and that move is the replacement. But it also adds a re-export from `merge-gate.service.ts` so that `land.service.ts:17` can keep its old import path, and the comment says "a later task switches that import and drops this line". That is the backwards-compat re-export that [`docs/conventions/general.md` §150-151](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/7f456ba0d48e00b3abcc1593cb149ed036966e9c/docs/conventions/general.md#L150-L151) rules out:

> **Delete old code when you replace it.** No compatibility shims, no `// removed` markers, no backwards-compat re-exports. The replacement *is* the change.

No decision or convention allows deferring this. `land.service.ts` is the only consumer, and it already imports `GATE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS` from `./merge-gate.constants.js`, so the fix is one import line:

1. Import `COMMIT_SHA` from `./merge-gate.constants.js` in `land.service.ts`.
2. Delete these two lines.
3. Drop the "`merge-gate.service.ts` re-exports it for `land.service.ts` only, until a later task…" sentence from the decision 86 amendment.

https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/7f456ba0d48e00b3abcc1593cb149ed036966e9c/src/core/merge-gate.service.ts#L91-L92

findings.description: The new exported `RegatePlan` interface, and `PullRequestPlan` (now `export interface` in merge-gate.service.ts:757), are inlined in `*.service.ts` files, against general.md §Type separation ("Never inline an exported type/interface in a *.service.ts"). They belong in `src/core/types/merge-gate.types.ts`. Other services already do the same, so this is a nit.

The decision 86 amendment breaks mid-sentence ("No behaviour changed: every" then a short line), so the paragraph needs re-wrapping. It also reads like a changelog: the 133→176→150 decision-point history doesn't add anything the decision needs.

merge-gate.service.ts and regate.service.ts now import each other. To allow that, merge-gate.service.ts newly exports measureBranch, refuseGate, commitSubjectsBetween, fileAcceptedDebt, recordMerge, pullRequestText, debtKind, withLedgerKept and PullRequestPlan. The cycle is safe today, but any future module-level use in either file would break it. A shared helpers module that both depend on would make the dependency one-way.

runMergeGate now keeps two optionals, `pullRequest` and `regate`, where exactly one is set, and the type no longer says so. A single `plan` variable narrowed with `'regate' in plan`, or a discriminated union, would state that once.
The new `dropReviewBranch` helper sits between `expectRefusedUnwritten` and `plantMerge`, which splits the existing helper block. It's minor ordering churn.
